name: lecture-ppt-workflow
description: Teacher-guided editable lecture slides from handouts, reference decks, and feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and revise editable teaching slides with teacher review.
interface.longDescription: Use a handout, reference deck, and teacher feedback to prepare editable lecture slides. Includes knowledge mapping, teaching notes, local checks, and an original demo. Early access: local dependencies and teacher review are required.
defaultPrompt: Turn my handout and reference deck into editable lecture slides with teaching notes.
Revise only the slides I name, preserve the knowledge, and explain each change.
根据我的讲义和标准课件制作教学 PPT，先检查环境，保留授课备注并逐页核验。
